{NO_CLICK}I'll give you ${SELL_PRICE}0 for that {PLANT_TYPE}!

These zombies appear in sets of four whenever Dancing Zombie rocks out.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} low {270}&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Backup Dancer Zombie spent six years perfecting his art at the Chewliard &cr;Performing Arts School in Zombie New York City.

Balloon Zombie floats above the fray, immune to most attacks.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} low {270}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} flying&cr;{KEYWORD}Weakness:{STAT} cactus and blover&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Balloon Zombie really lucked out. The balloon thing really works and &cr;none of the other zombies have picked up on it.

Blovers blow away all balloon zombies and fog.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, instant&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} blows away all balloon zombies&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}When Blover was five he got a shiny new birthday cake. Blover made his wish, huffed and puffed, &cr;but was able to extinguish only 60% of the candles. Instead of giving up, though, he's used that early &cr;defeat as a catalyst to push himself harder ever since.

Dr. Zomboss rules them all.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness (in Zombot shell):{STAT} extreme&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Edgar George Zomboss achieved his Doctorate in Thanatology in only two years. Quickly mastering &cr;thanatological technology, he built his fearsome Zombot and set about establishing absolute dominance of his local subdivision.

His bucket hat makes him extremely resistant to damage.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} high {1370}&cr;{KEYMETAL}Weakness:{METAL} magnet-shroom&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Buckethead Zombie always wore a bucket. Part of it was to assert his uniqueness &cr;in an uncaring world. Mostly he just forgot it was there in the first place.

Bungee Zombie attacks from above.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {400}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} descends from the sky and steals a plant&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Bungee Zombie loves to take risks. After all, what's the point of being dead if you don't live a little?

Cabbage-pults hurl cabbages at the enemy.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} lobbed&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Cabbage-pult is okay with launching cabbages at zombies. It's what he's paid for, after all, and &cr;he's good at it. He just doesn't understand how the zombies get up on the roof in the first place.

Cactuses shoot spikes that can hit both ground and air targets.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} ground and air&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}She's prickly, sure, but Cactus's spikes belie a spongy heart filled with love and goodwill. &cr;She just wants to hug and be hugged. Most folks can't hang with that, but Cactus doesn't mind. She's &cr;been seeing an armadillo for a while and it really seems to be working out.

Catapult Zombie operates heavy machinery.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {850}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} lobs basketballs at your plants&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Of all the things Catapult Zombie could launch with his catapult, basketballs seemed &cr;like the best and most obvious choice.

Cattails can attack any lane and shoot down balloon zombies too.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Must be planted on lily pads&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"Woof!" says Cattail. "Woof woof woof! Does this confuse you? Do you expect me to say 'Meow' &cr;like a cat just because the word 'cat' is in my name and I also look like a cat? That's not how things &cr;work around here. I refuse to be pigeonholed."

Cherry Bombs can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} all zombies in a medium area&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, instant&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"I wanna explode," says Cherry #1. "No, let's detonate instead!" says &cr;his brother, Cherry #2. After intense consultation they agree to explodonate.

Chompers can devour a zombie whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} very short&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} long delay between chomps&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Chomper almost got a gig doing stunts for The Little Shop of Horrors but it fell &cr;through when his agent demanded too much on the front end. Chomper's not resentful, &cr;though. He says it's just part of the business.

Click on the Cob Cannon to launch deadly cobs of corn.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Must be planted on 2 side-by-side kernel-pults&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}What's the deal with Cob Cannon, anyway? He went to Harvard. He practices law in a prestigious &cr;New York firm. He can explode whole areas of zombies with a single corn-launch. All this is common knowledge. &cr;But deep inside, what really makes him tick?

Use Coffee Beans to wake up sleeping mushrooms.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, instant&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} can be planted over another plant, wakes up mushrooms&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"Hey, guys, hey!" says Coffee Bean. "Hey! What's up? Who's that? Hey! Didja see that thing? &cr;What thing? Whoa! Lions!" Yep, Coffee Bean sure does get excited.

His traffic cone headpiece makes him twice as tough as normal zombies.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {640}&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Conehead Zombie shuffled mindlessly forward like every other zombie.&cr;But something made him stop, made him pick up a traffic cone and stick it on his head. Oh yeah. He likes to party.

Any resemblance between Dancing Zombie and persons living or dead is purely coincidental.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {500}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} summons back-up dancers&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Dancing Zombie's latest album, "GrarrBRAINSarblarbl," is already rocketing up the undead charts.

This zombie digs to bypass your defenses.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {370}&cr;{KEYWORD}Speed:{STAT} fast, then slow&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} tunnels underground and appears on the left side of the lawn&cr;{KEYWORD}Weakness:{STAT} split pea{METAL} and magnet-shroom{KEYWORD}&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Digger Zombie spends three days a week getting his excavation permits in order.

Dolphin Rider Zombies use dolphins to exploit weaknesses in your pool defense.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {500}&cr;{KEYWORD}Speed:{STAT} fast, then slow (after jump)&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} jumps over the first plant he runs into&cr;{AQUATIC}Only appears in the pool&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}The dolphin is also a zombie.

Doom-shrooms destroy everything in a large area and leave a crater that can't be planted on.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} all zombies in a huge area&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, instant&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} leaves a crater&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"You're lucky I'm on your side," says Doom-shroom. "I could destroy everything you hold dear. It wouldn't be hard."

The ducky tube allows this zombie to float on water.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} low {270}&cr;{AQUATIC}Only appears in the pool&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}It takes a certain kind of zombie to be a Ducky Tuber. Not every zombie can handle it. &cr;Some crack. They can't take it. They walk away and give up on brains forever.

Flag Zombie marks the arrival of a huge pile or "wave" of zombies.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} low {270}&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Make no mistake, Flag Zombie loves brains. But somewhere down the line he also picked &cr;up a fascination with flags. Maybe it's because the flags always have brains on them. Hard to say.

Flower Pots let you plant on the roof.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} allows you to plant on the roof&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"I'm a pot for planting. Yet I'm also a plant. HAS YOUR MIND EXPLODED YET?"

Football Zombie makes the big plays.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} very high {1670}&cr;{KEYWORD}Speed:{STAT} fast&cr;{KEYMETAL}Weakness:{METAL} magnet-shroom&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Football Zombie gives 110 percent whenever he's on the field. He's a team player &cr;who delivers both offensively and defensively. He has no idea what a football is.

Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that can pass through screen doors.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal, penetrates screen doors&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} all zombies in the fume cloud&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"I was in a dead-end job producing yeast spores for a bakery," says Fume-shroom. &cr;"Then Puff-shroom, bless 'im, told me about this great opportunity blasting zombies. Now I really feel like I'm making a difference."

Gargantuar is a gigantic zombie.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} extremely high {3000}&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}When Gargantuar walks, the earth trembles. When he moans, other zombies fall silent.&cr;He is the zombie other zombies dream they could be. But he still can't find a girlfriend.

Garlic diverts zombies into other lanes.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} on contact&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} diverts zombies into other lanes&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Lane-diversion isn't just Garlic's profession. It's his passion. He carries an advanced Doctorate &cr;in Redirection from the Brussels University. He'll talk all day about lane vectors and repulse arrays. &cr;He even pushes things into alternate avenues at home. Somehow his wife puts up with it.

Gatling Peas shoot four peas at a time.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal (for each pea)&cr;{KEYWORD}Firing Speed:{STAT} 4x&cr;{KEYWORD}Must be planted on repeaters&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Gatling Pea's parents were concerned when he announced his intention to join the military. &cr;"But honey, it's so dangerous!" they said in unison. Gatling Pea refused to budge. "Life is dangerous," &cr;he replied, eyes glinting with steely conviction.

Gloom-shrooms release heavy fumes in an area around themselves.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Must be planted on fume-shrooms&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"I've always enjoyed releasing heavy fumes," says Gloom Shroom. "I know a lot of people aren't &cr;cool with that. They say it's rude or that it smells bad. All I can say is, would you rather have your &cr;brain eaten by zombies?"

Gold Magnets collect coins and diamonds for you.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Must be planted on magnet-shrooms&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"How did I end up here?" asks Gold Magnet. "I was on the fast track --corner office, full &cr;benefits, stock options. I was gonna be Vice President of Midwestern Operations. Now I'm here, on this &cr;lawn, in serious danger of being eaten to death. Ooh! A coin!"

Plant Grave Busters on graves to remove the graves.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, must be planted on graves&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} removes graves&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Despite Grave Buster's fearsome appearance, he wants everyone to know that he loves &cr;kittens and spends his off hours volunteering at a local zombie rehabilitation center. "It's just the right thing to do," he says.

When eaten, Hypno-shrooms will make a zombie turn around and fight for you.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, on contact&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} makes a zombie fight for you&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"Zombies are our friends," asserts Hypno-shroom. "They're badly misunderstood creatures &cr;who play a valuable role in our ecology. We can and should do more to bring them round to our way of thinking."

Ice-shrooms temporarily immobilize all zombies on the screen.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} very light, immobilizes zombies&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} all zombies on the screen&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, instant&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Ice-shroom frowns, not because he's unhappy or because he disapproves, but because of a childhood injury that left his facial nerves paralyzed.

Imitaters let you use two of the same plant during a level!&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"I remember the Zombie Wars back in '76," says Imitater in a raspy, old-man's voice. "Back then, &cr;we didn't have all these fancy peashooters and jalapenos. All we had was guts. Guts and a spoon."

Imps are tiny zombies hurled by Gargantuar deep into your defenses.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} low {270}&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Imp may be small, but he's wiry. He's proficient in zombie judo, zombie karate &cr;and zombie bare-knuckle brawling. He also plays the melodica.

This zombie carries an explosive surprise.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {500}&cr;{KEYWORD}Speed:{STAT} fast&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} jack-in-the-box explodes&cr;{KEYMETAL}Weakness:{METAL} magnet-shroom&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}This zombie shivers, not because he's cold but because he's crazy.

Jalapenos destroy an entire lane of zombies.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} all zombies in a lane&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, instant&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"NNNNNGGGGGG!!!!!!!!" Jalapeno says. He's not going to explode, not this time. But soon. Oh, so soon. &cr;It's close. He knows it, he can feel it, his whole life's been leading up to this moment.

Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and butter at zombies.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} light (kernel), normal (butter)&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} lobbed&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} butter immobilizes zombies&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Kernel-Pult is the eldest of the Pult brothers. Of the three of them, Kernel is the only one &cr;who consistently remembers the others' birthdays. He bugs them about it a little, too.

Ladder Zombie climbs over obstacles.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {500}&cr;{KEYWORD}Ladder Toughness:{STAT} medium {500}&cr;{KEYWORD}Speed:{STAT} fast, then slow (after placing ladder)&cr;{KEYWORD}Weakness:{STAT} fume-shroom{METAL} and magnet-shroom{KEYWORD}&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}He picked the ladder up for $8.99.

Lily pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} non-aquatic plants can be planted on top of it&cr;{AQUATIC}Must be planted in water&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Lily Pad never complains. Lily Pad never wants to know what's going on. Put a plant on top of Lily Pad, &cr;he won't say a thing. Does he have startling opinions or shocking secrets? Nobody knows. Lily Pad keeps it all inside.

Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} nearby zombies&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} removes metal objects from zombies&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Magnetism is a powerful force. Very powerful. Sometimes it scares Magnet-shroom a little. He's &cr;not sure if he can handle that kind of responsibility.

Marigolds give you silver and gold coins.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} gives coins&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Marigold spends a lot of time deciding whether to spit out a silver coin or a gold one. She &cr;thinks about it, weighs the angles. She does solid research and keeps up with current publications. &cr;That's how winners stay ahead.

Melon-pults do heavy damage to groups of zombies.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} heavy&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} lobbed&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} melons damage nearby enemies on impact&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}There's no false modesty with Melon-pult. "Sun-for-damage, I deliver the biggest punch on &cr;the lawn," he says. "I'm not bragging. Run the numbers. You'll see."

His newspaper provides limited defense.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} low {270}&cr;{KEYWORD}Newspaper Toughness:{STAT} low {150}&cr;{KEYWORD}Speed:{STAT} normal, then fast (after losing newspaper)&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Newspaper Zombie was *this* close to finishing his sudoku puzzle. No wonder he's freaking out.

Peashooters are your first line of defense. They shoot peas at attacking zombies.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}How can a single plant grow and shoot so many peas so quickly? Peashooter says, &cr;"Hard work, commitment, and a healthy, well-balanced breakfast of sunlight and high-fiber &cr;carbon dioxide make it all possible."

Planterns light up an area, letting you see through fog.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} one lane&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} lets you see through fog&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Plantern defies science. He just does. Other plants eat light and excrete oxygen; Plantern eats &cr;darkness and excretes light. Plantern's cagey about how he does it. "I'm not gonna say 'sorcery,' I &cr;wouldn't use the term 'dark forces,' I just... I think I've said enough."

Pogo Zombie hops to bypass your defenses.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {500}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} hops over plants&cr;{KEYMETAL}Weakness:{METAL} magnet-shroom&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Sproing! Sproing! Sproing! That's the sound of a powerful and effective zombie doing what he does best.

Pole Vaulting Zombie vaults with a pole.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} medium {500}&cr;{KEYWORD}Speed:{STAT} fast, then normal (after jump)&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} jumps the first plant he runs into&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Some zombies take it further, aspire more, push themselves beyond the &cr;normal into greatness. That's Pole Vaulting Zombie right there. That is so him.

Potato Mines pack a powerful punch, but they need a while to arm themselves. You should plant them ahead of zombies. They will explode on contact.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} all zombies in a small area&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, delayed activation&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Some folks say Potato Mine is lazy, that he leaves everything to the last &cr;minute. Potato Mine says nothing. He's too busy thinking about his investment strategy.

Puff-shrooms are cheap, but can only fire a short distance.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} short&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"I only recently became aware of the existence of zombies," says Puff-shroom. "Like many fungi, &cr;I'd just assumed they were fairy tales or movie monsters. This whole experience has been a huge eye-opener for me."

Pumpkins protect plants that are within their shells.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} high&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} can be planted over another plant&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Pumpkin hasn't heard from his cousin Renfield lately. Apparently Renfield's a big star, some kind &cr;of... what was it... sports hero? Peggle Master? Pumpkin doesn't really get it. He just does his job.

Repeaters fire two peas at a time.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal (for each pea)&cr;{KEYWORD}Firing speed:{STAT} 2x&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Repeater is fierce. He's from the streets. He doesn't take attitude from anybody, &cr;plant or zombie, and he shoots peas to keep people at a distance. Secretly, though, Repeater yearns for love.

Scaredy-shrooms are long-ranged shooters that hide when enemies get near them.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} stops shooting when enemy is close&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"Who's there?" whispers Scaredy-shroom, voice barely audible. "Go away. I don't want to see anybody. Unless it's the man from the circus."

His screen door is an effective shield.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} low {270}&cr;{KEYWORD}Screen Door Toughness:{STAT} high {1100}&cr;{KEYWORD}Weakness:{STAT} fume-shroom{METAL} and magnet-shroom{KEYWORD}&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}He got his screen door from the last inexpertly defended home he visited, after he ATE THE HOMEOWNER'S BRAINS.

Sea-shrooms are aquatic plants that shoot short ranged spores.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} short&cr;{AQUATIC}Must be planted in water&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Sea-shroom has never seen the sea. It's in his name, he's heard loads about it, but he's just never found the time. One day, though, it'll go down.

Snorkel zombies can swim underwater.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} low {270}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} submerges to avoid attacks&cr;{AQUATIC}Only appears in the pool&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Zombies don't breathe. They don't need air. So why does Snorkel Zombie need a snorkel to swim underwater?{KEYWORD}&cr;{FLAVOR}Answer: peer pressure.

Snow Peas shoot frozen peas that damage and slow the enemy.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal, slows zombies&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Folks often tell Snow Pea how "cool" he is, or exhort him to "chill out." They &cr;tell him to "stay frosty." Snow Pea just rolls his eyes. He's heard 'em all.

Spikerocks pop multiple tires and damage zombies that walk over it.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Must be planted on spikeweeds&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Spikerock just got back from a trip to Europe. He had a great time, met some wonderful people, &cr;really broadened his horizons. He never knew they made museums so big, or put so many paintings in them. &cr;That was a big surprise for him.

Spikeweeds pop tires and hurt any zombies that step on them.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} all zombies that walk over it&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} can't be eaten by zombies&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Hockey is Spikeweed's obsession. He's got box seat season tickets. He keeps close track of his favorite &cr;players. And he consistently cleans up in the office hockey pool. Just one problem: he's terrified of pucks.

Split Peas shoot peas forward and backwards.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} forward and backwards&cr;{KEYWORD}Firing Speed:{STAT} 1x forward, 2x backwards&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"Yeah, I'm a Gemini," says Split Pea. "I know, big surprise. But having two heads --or really, &cr;one head with a large head-like growth on the back-- pays off big in my line of work."

Squashes will smash the first zombie that gets close to it.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} short range, hits all zombies that it lands on&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"I'm ready!" yells Squash. "Let's do it! Put me in! There's nobody better! I'm your guy! C'mon! Whaddya waiting for? I need this!"

Starfruits shoot stars in 5 directions.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} 5 directions&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"Aw, man," says Starfruit. "I went to the dentist the other day and he said I have four cavities. &cr;I've got --count it-- ONE tooth! Four cavities in one tooth? How does this happen?"

Sunflowers are essential for you to produce extra sun. Try planting as many as you can!&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Sun production:{STAT} normal&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Sunflower can't resist bouncing to the beat. Which beat is that? Why, the &cr;life-giving jazzy rhythm of the Earth itself, thumping at a frequency only Sunflower can hear.

Sun-shrooms give small sun at first and normal sun later.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Sun production:{STAT} low, then normal&cr;{NOCTURNAL}Sleeps during the day&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Sun-shroom hates sun. He hates it so much that when it builds up in his system, &cr;he spits it out as fast as he can. He just won't abide it. To him, sun is crass.

Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that can't be vaulted over.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Toughness:{STAT} very high&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} can't be vaulted or jumped over&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}People wonder if there's a rivalry between Wall-nut and Tall-nut. Tall-nut laughs a rich, baritone &cr;laugh. "How could there be anything between us? We are brothers. If you knew what Wall-nut has done for me..." &cr;Tall-nut's voice trails off and he smiles knowingly.

Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive&cr;{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, on contact&cr;{AQUATIC}Must be planted in water&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}"I'm totally invisible," Tangle Kelp thinks to himself. "I'll hide here just below the surface and &cr;nobody will see me." His friends tell him they can see him perfectly well, but he'll never change.

Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} normal (for each pea)&cr;{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} three lanes&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{FLAVOR}Threepeater likes reading, backgammon and long periods of immobility in the park. Threepeater enjoys &cr;going to shows, particularly modern jazz. "I'm just looking for that special someone," he says. Threepeater's favorite number is 5.

Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage.&cr;{SHORTLINE}&cr;{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} doubles the damage of peas that pass through it.
